rule: Enclose every prior pivot, every endpoint within requested XZ plus/minus five units, and every eased phase up to the age+1 update upper bound. No exact endpoint or phase is selected.
start: 3065bb8 obtains the server current start before strategy setup. Recursively use the prior-position envelope evaluated at the command. An unsupported or missing predecessor rejects.
height: 11a6400 changes only Y at 11a65dd/11a65e0 or 11a65eb; XZ is preserved on every returning branch.
endpoint: 12a146c loads maxDistance=5. At 12a14ac, 11a4a50 applies height correction, then NavMesh.SamplePosition. Success returns a point within five units; failure preserves requested XZ.
phase: Positive fixed-point duration/100. At most age+1 updates with float32 accumulation/division allowance. Linear21 uses phase. Monotone EaseOutQuad1 uses phase*(2-phase)+2^-20; monotone EaseOutCubic4 uses 1-(1-phase)^3+2^-20; both are clamped at one. Include phase zero for paused or not-yet-updated movement.
cubicProof: GetEasingFunction 1451dc0: jump-table entry 4 at 14525c4 targets 14520da. MethodInfo loaded at 14520e6 from a642230 is Method$Blis.Common.EasingFunction.EaseOutCubic(), native 1450290. Native instructions subtract 1, multiply v*v*v, add 1, then scale by end-start and add start. Both constants are exact float32 1. Caller 11af450 passes start=0/end=1; 11af452..11af465 clamps the result to [0,1]. The derivative 3*(1-phase)^2 is nonnegative on [0,1]. The 2^-20 allowance exceeds the absolute error from the four float32 operations on this domain (including the initial subtraction); coordinate arithmetic retains its separate padding.
roundoff: Use endpoint radius5+1/128 and output padding(frames+1)/128 in the finite coordinate domain abs<=512.
limits: No exact navigation endpoint, pause state, elapsed time, or tile association assumed
